documentation.text:
@dev Network admins keeps intrack of the information related to events.
 Each netwok admin represents a supported network and soters the information related
 to that network.
 Network admins are deployed from the administration contracts and only the administration
 contract can manipulate data inside the contract.
@dev Network id of the network that the contract represents.

@dev Fees are recorded only for native contributions to reduce gas for the contributor.
 Fees are manually withdrawn from the Examiner contract.
@dev Stores the receiving addresses of the events.

@dev Keeps in track of the native currency contributions received for an event from the
 represented network.

@dev Keeps in track of the ERC20 contributions received for an event from the represented
 network.

@dev Records the native currency contributions received and fees.
 Fee factor is sent as a argument from the administration contract

@dev Records the ERC20 contributions received.
 Fees are not recorded in ERC20 contributions cause the fees are distriubted immediatly.

devdoc.details: Network admins keeps intrack of the information related to events. Each netwok admin represents a supported network and soters the information related to that network. Network admins are deployed from the administration contracts and only the administration contract can manipulate data inside the contract.

addNativeContributions(uint256,uint256,u.details: Records the native currency contributions received and fees. Fee factor is sent as a argument from the administration contract

addTokenContributions(uint256,uint256,ad.details: Records the ERC20 contributions received. Fees are not recorded in ERC20 contributions cause the fees are distriubted immediatly.

changeReceiver(address,uint256).details: Creator of the event can change the receiving address for the represented network by calling the contract through the Administration contract. Event owners cannot call the network admin contract directly.

admin.details: Address of the Administration contract. Only Administration contract can manipulate data inside the contract.

contributionsReceived.details: Keeps in track of the native currency contributions received for an event from the represented network.

fees.details: Fees are recorded only for native contributions to reduce gas for the contributor. Fees are manually withdrawn from the Examiner contract.

network.details: Network id of the network that the contract represents.

receivers.details: Stores the receiving addresses of the events.

tokenContributionsReceived.details: Keeps in track of the ERC20 contributions received for an event from the represented network.
